[[Devona]] asks you to fetch [[Duke Barradin]]'s tithe from [[Grazden the Protector]] in [[Green Hills County]].

==Quest information==
===Requirements===
{{ Standard prerequisites
| campaign = pre
| test = n
| complete = [[Unsettling Rumors]]
}}

===Objectives===
* Head due north from [[Ashford]] until you find the road to Green Hills County. Go to Green Hills County and talk to Grazden the Protector.
* Deliver [[Barradin's Tithe]] to Devona.

===Reward===
* 250 [[Experience]]
* 25 [[Gold]] ({{reforgedmode}} only)
* 1 [[Skill Point]]

==Walkthrough==
After talking to Devona, you can go straight to the north eastern limit of the map where the portal to Green Hills County is located. Map traveling to [[Ashford Abbey]] and starting from the entrance of the outpost can spare you a bit of time instead of starting from Devona's location.

Right after the portal there is a statue of [[Balthazar]]. Behind it, you will spot a [[Resurrection Shrine]] where Grazden the Protector can be found. Map travel to Ashford Abbey and return to Devona to deliver the tithe and claim your reward.

==Dialogue==
===Initial dialogue===
;Devona
:''"You've shown yourself to be courageous and trustworthy. I could use your help. With so many [[bandit]]s and troublemakers around these days, [[Brother Mhenlo]] has asked for my help in collecting the tithe for Ashford Abbey. Duke Barradin is especially generous to the church and I suspect bandits will attempt to intercept his donation.''

:''Can you get '''Barradin's tithe''' from his man '''Grazden''' and deliver it to me? Grazden will be in '''Green Hills County''', north of here."''
{{ Offer dialog
| accept = I'll do what I can to help.
| decline = I'm sorry. I don't have time for this.
| ask = To find '''Grazden''', just go north until you reach a road and then follow the signs to Green Hills County.
}}

===Intermediate dialogue===
;Grazden the Protector
:''"You're here to collect Barradin's tithe? You look like you could use a little assistance on the return trip. I'm certain that [[Dwayna]] will be watching over you should you encounter any bandits on your way back."''

===Reward dialogue===
;Devona
:''"Thank you for delivering the tithe. I trust you didn't run into any trouble you couldn't handle. You can be sure I will pass word of your bravery on to [[Sir Tydus]]."''

==Notes==
* While the initial, intermediate, and reward dialogue all allude to an encounter with bandits, no bandits are encountered as part of this quest.
